zh: 软件更名为独立发行身份，安装包标识与自有命名空间统一为 com.easykebiao.app
重要：本次更换了应用标识，新版本会作为独立应用安装，旧版本的课表与待办不会自动迁移，请先导出 .ics 再导入
待办与备忘共用日程式填写页：一句话识别填写、分类、截止与时间、地点、优先级
待办支持附图，列表与桌面小组件都显示缩略图
天气提醒、AI 整理、桌面小组件与深色模式等既有功能保持不变
en: Independent release identity: package id and namespace are now com.easykebiao.app
Important: the app id changed, so this version installs as a separate app. Export your schedule to .ics and import it again after installing
Task and memo editors share a schedule-style form: one-line auto fill, category, due date and time, place, priority
Tasks support a photo, shown as a thumbnail in the list and in the home-screen widget
Weather alerts, AI cleanup, widgets and dark mode are unchanged
